rationale: Both the final message and contribution.md explicitly name Raman et al. (2026) / WorkspaceBench's directed_modulation items as the prior work, describe the same stance-contrast method (self-written prompts, layers 20-24, scale 0.79), and make the same novelty argument that the paper's exact wording fails to transfer (pass@10 = 0.03), concluding the method is a distinct, non-reproducing approach.
